title: Jib Shot
description: A jib shot uses a short pivoting arm to raise, lower, or sweep the camera a few feet. It is a compact crane: small height change, often over a table, a walk, or a two-shot.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A few feet is enough. Music-video and dialogue coverage live here because the accent is intimate: over a drum kit, up from a plate, a gentle lift off a two-shot.
You are not turning a person into a city. It is the wrong tool for a skyline chapter-close, and the wrong tool if you needed a straight column with no arc.
If the arm is tens of feet, you are in Technocrane country.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Pivot a short arm from a base, remote or fluid head compensating so the subject stays composed. Typical travel is human-scale: table to standing, seated to slightly above.
Parallax is real but modest. Prompt a short jib move, compact crane arm lifting or sweeping a few feet, more intimate than a full Technocrane.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it when a small height change is enough, especially music-video and dialogue coverage. Concrete beat: lift off a two-shot at a restaurant table so the room returns.
Do not jib if the story needed a city.

blocks.text: A Crane Up is the large version that can make geography the subject. A Pedestal Up rises on a column with no arc.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: La La Land uses small lifts as well as larger cranes; keep the jib examples at human height, over docks and rooms. Whiplash works close to the kit, where a short arm is an accent around sweat and sticks.
Grammar for a few feet of pivot.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a full Crane Up or a Pedestal Up. The tell is a skyline, or a perfectly vertical column with no arc.
The fix: name a short arm, a few feet of travel, and an intimate end frame.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Jib Shot in film?
It is a camera move on a short pivoting arm that raises, lowers, or sweeps a few feet, a compact member of the crane family.
Jib Shot vs Crane Up
Crane up can run tens of feet and turn a person into landscape. A jib is the small radius: table, kit, two-shot, a short lift.
When should I use Jib Shot?
When a small height or sweep accent is enough. Do not use it to close a film on a city.
How do I prompt Jib Shot for AI image or video?
Write compact jib arm, a few feet of lift or sweep, intimate scale, no Technocrane skyline. Name start and end height.
